scope: Bitcoin-only private local research; no public redistribution cleared; not uploaded.

price_gold_oz.valueDefinition: Mean of available daily Coin Metrics PriceUSD closes in the calendar month divided by the World Bank Pink Sheet monthly average gold price in USD per troy ounce.

etf_holdings_btc.aggregation: Sum the five reported fund balances only on dates when all five exact-date values are present. No forward fill or missing-date imputation.
etf_holdings_btc.knownCoverageLimit: Five issuer series from a third-party repository; the repository documents seven US spot ETF products without machine-readable daily holdings. This is not total US spot ETF holdings.

rights.worldBankPinkSheet: World Bank-produced open dataset, attribution required under CC BY 4.0 default; only the ratio is in the candidate.
rights.bitcoinPrice: Uses existing Coin Metrics Community PriceUSD rows. Keep private/non-commercial pending any public redistribution review.
rights.etfHoldings: Repository code has MIT license but its README says data files remain subject to original source terms. The extracted issuer data remain private/local pending source-rights review.
